subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram slash sessions still resolve to channel=(unknown), causing elevated allowFrom checks to fail on 2026.3.13

question: Which fix shape should own the Telegram slash-session channel identity repair for elevated `allowFrom` diagnostics?
rationale: The source-visible bug touches elevated host-command authorization diagnostics, and the linked candidate PRs propose different session-key normalization versus channel-registry fallback approaches.

options.title: Adopt scoped-key normalization
options.body: Normalize bare channel-prefixed session keys into the canonical agent-scoped shape before session lookup and channel inference, then add regression and Telegram proof.

options.title: Use channel-prefix fallback
options.body: Teach diagnostics to infer the channel from bare prefixes without changing the session key shape, accepting a second inference path.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer runs a live Telegram elevated-flow repro and chooses the repair boundary from that evidence.

recommendation.title: Adopt scoped-key normalization
recommendation.body: Normalize bare channel-prefixed session keys into the canonical agent-scoped shape before session lookup and channel inference, then add regression and Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the best available routing owner from current-main blame plus live issue subscription for this security-sensitive session diagnostic path.
